text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When we stopped by an amusement park on 
the way back from our outing. Espoir City 
suddenly cast her eyes toward the arcade 
area.

text_block_list.name: Game Demo Movie
text_block_list.text:
"Take on the zombie horde! Giant screen × 
booming sound × 4D vibrations! Clear the 
game to get an exclusive mug set!"
choice_data_list: You wanna play that game?
Do you wanna play that game?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's not it. It's just that the 
pattern on that mug—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems what Espoir City actually has her 
eyes on is the pair of matching mugs 
offered as a prize.
choice_data_list: (Huh? That character is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The character drawn on the mug closely 
resembled the fluffy, white fur on her 
racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, she named it "Hop-chan" and 
is secretly doting on it. However—

text_block_list.name: Game Demo Movie
text_block_list.text: (Aaaah! *Crash! Boom!*)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch. It's not like I wanted it that 
badly anyway…….
choice_data_list: Is it okay if I go give it a try?
Mind if I go give it a shot real quick?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? Did you actually like those 
kinds of games?
choice_data_list:
There's a girl I really want to give that 
prize to.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh~... ...Well, whatever, I don't really 
care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the massive screen, a horde of zombies 
comes crawling... I take aim and pull the 
trigger."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!! BANG BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Th-They really went all out with this 
game, huh...
choice_data_list:
You could have just waited outside, you 
know.

You could have just waited outside, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~!? You really think I'd be scared of 
something like this!?

text_block_list.name: Zombie A
text_block_list.text: Gwoooaaah~~!!
choice_data_list: ! Crap, I have to fight back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!! BANG BANG!!) (KA-BOOM! KA-BOOM!!)
choice_data_list: Alright, target down... You good, Espo?

Alright, target down... Wait, you okay, 
Espo?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course I'm fine! Just go to the next 
stage already, the next...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Under the watchful eye of Espoir City, 
who tries to act tough, you clear the 
stage. But when it comes to the final boss 
battle—"
choice_data_list: Kuh, beaten again...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi, aren't you good for now? Curfew's 
comin' up soon, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I try, I can't 
win, and my concentration is pushed to its 
absolute limit. ...Just like she said, 
maybe it's better to give up here.
choice_data_list: Even so, just one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You'd go that far just to get a 
mug?
choice_data_list: Well, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she naturally has a sensitive side, 
Espoir City is always psyching herself up 
to stay strong and give it her all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she's like that—sometimes, I want 
to create moments where she can let her 
guard down.
choice_data_list:
I really, truly want to see that kid's 
happy face.

I really, truly want to see that girl's 
happy face.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You... ...What's with you, getting so 
desperate...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaagh, geez!!!! I'm gonna do it too, 
dammit!!
choice_data_list: E-Espo?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't just space out!! Let's hurry up and 
beat the final boss, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! They're weakening!! Time to make 
our move all at once!!
choice_data_list: Yeah! At this rate—we can do it!
Yeah! At this rate—we can do it!

text_block_list.name: Final Boss
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Tch... As if I'd ever get cold feet!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you get cocky with me, dammit!! If 
you're gonna look down on me—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Let's smash 'em up, RRAAAAAAGH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from the amusement park. 
Carrying the bag with the matching mugs 
won as prizes, she heads triumphantly 
toward the academy.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What's with that dopey look on your face? 
Did you really want that thing that badly?
choice_data_list:
Because I absolutely had to give this to 
you—here!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "This bag... ...Wait, could this be...?"
choice_data_list: I just really wanted you to have it!
I just really wanted you to have it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Whaaaat?!? The person you wanted 
to give it to is me?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I didn't say a single thing about 
wanting one, though?! Like I wanted it... 
and yet they gave me something like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Siiiiigh. How do I put this... you really 
are an idiot, aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
These mugs are a matching pair, right? 
Having two of them is just in the way.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You take responsibility for one of them, 
bastard.
choice_data_list: I see. Thanks a lot!
I see. Thanks!
I'm glad, it was such a cute mug

It was a little scary, but it was worth 
the effort.

It was a little scary, but it was worth 
the effort, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You take responsibility for one of them, 
bastard.
choice_data_list: I see. Thanks a lot!
I see. Thanks!
I'm glad, it was such a cute mug

It was a little scary, but it was worth 
the effort.

It was a little scary, but it was worth 
the effort, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why are you thanking me, dummy! Just take 
it quietly already!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—said Espoir City, her face bright red as 
she shoved the bag into my hands."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ya think so? Doesn't make much sense to 
me, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her words, Espoir City looked 
secretly pleased.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Getting freaked out is pathetic. That 
was just the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Espoir City talked big, her tail 
swayed anxiously to and fro.
